title: Gender Quotas in Hiring Committees: A Boon or a Bane for Women?
eligible_reason: Single adoption date and fake data. The French 2015 hiring-committee gender quota (40% threshold) applies to all committees at one date; treat = committee below the 40% threshold before the quota, dum = post-quota x below-40% (variable dictionary). Main regressions (Table 2a, 4, 5) are contest-level OLS of gendwi etc. on dum treat ref plus time-varying committee controls (gpres, RapportFH, prof, topgh) with field and year or establishment dummies, so the design is a two-group single-date DiD with controls; Table 2 (rank level) is conditional logit. The README states the university hiring data are confidential and replaced by a fake dataset; only Sim.do (simulated) and Aggregate.do (Table OA.15, public ministry data) reproduce the paper.
design_notes: Contest-level (Contest_data.dta) and candidate-rank-level (Rank_data.dta) data from three French university archives, 2009-2018. Quota effective 2015. Aggregate.do (online appendix Table OA.15): reghdfe percenthired rapportfh ratiocandidatspublies dum [aweight=postes], absorb(gr year), section-year panel from public ministry data; dum = post-quota x below-40% section (single date, time-varying controls, appendix only).
estimators_reported: triple differences by candidate gender x year
